name: ITMAX
recent: ITMAX 近期持续推进 AI 交通管理平台，计划到 2027 年部署 17,000 台摄像头，并采用 Nvidia 芯片。公司 2026 年第二季度业绩创纪录，净利同比增长 30.1%。此外，公司有多项员工购股权计划（ESOS）新股上市，以及董事和主要股东的股权变动。
notable: 公司计划到 2027 年将 AI 交通管理平台扩展至 17,000 台摄像头，并采用 Nvidia 芯片。
2026 年第二季度净利同比增长 30.1%，营收同比增长 28.3%，创纪录。
多名董事及主要股东（包括独立非执行主席、CFO 等）在公开市场处置股份。
risks: 首席财务官 Shaun Tee Wen Han 于 2026 年 10 月 16 日处置 10,000 股普通股。
独立非执行主席 Tan Sri Dato' Seri Dr. Ir. Ahmad Tajuddin Bin Ali 于 2026 年 10 月 14 日处置 80,000 股普通股。
公司持续通过 ESOS 发行新股，最新一批于 2026 年 11 月 6 日上市，可能对每股盈利造成轻微摊薄。
earnings: 2026 年第二季度（截至 6 月 30 日）营收为 74,999,000 令吉，净利为 30,010,000 令吉，净利率 40.0%。营收环比增长 13.9%，净利环比增长 20.0%；营收同比增长 28.3%，净利同比增长 30.1%。

recent_en: ITMAX is advancing its AI traffic management platform, targeting 17,000 cameras by 2027 using Nvidia chips. The company posted record 2Q 2026 results with net profit up 30.1% year-on-year. There were also multiple listings of new shares under its ESOS and changes in directors' and substantial shareholders' interests.
notable_en: The company plans to expand its AI traffic management platform to 17,000 cameras by 2027, using Nvidia chips.
2Q 2026 net profit rose 30.1% year-on-year and revenue grew 28.3% year-on-year, setting a record.
Several directors and substantial shareholders, including the Independent Non-Executive Chairman and CFO, disposed of shares in the open market.
risks_en: Chief Financial Officer Shaun Tee Wen Han disposed of 10,000 ordinary shares on 16 October 2026.
Independent Non-Executive Chairman Tan Sri Dato' Seri Dr. Ir. Ahmad Tajuddin Bin Ali disposed of 80,000 ordinary shares on 14 October 2026.
The company continues to issue new shares under its ESOS, with the latest batch listed on 6 November 2026, which may cause slight dilution to earnings per share.
earnings_en: For 2Q 2026 (ended 30 June), revenue was MYR 74,999,000 and net profit was MYR 30,010,000, with a net margin of 40.0%. Revenue grew 13.9% QoQ and net profit rose 20.0% QoQ; revenue increased 28.3% YoY and net profit increased 30.1% YoY.
